context.transcript:
I'm excited to give this presentation on behalf of Nexflight Labs.
I enjoy attending this conference every year, and this year, I get to lead a session.
Today, Ill be sharing the research on flying vehicles that Nexflight has done.
My team ensures that the vehicles our company designs are as light as possible.
This is important because vehicles that weigh less require less energy to operate.
Over the past decade, our company has developed four prototypes.
Of these, Nexflight is most proud of the model that can accommodate six passengers.
Granted, 25 kilometers isn't a long flight range, but it is a great start.
context.transcript_translation:
我很高兴能代表 Nexflight Labs 进行这次演示。
我每年都喜欢参加这个会议，今年我有机会主持一个环节。
今天，我将分享 Nexflight 在飞行器方面的研究成果。
我的团队确保我们公司设计的飞行器尽可能轻。
这一点很重要，因为重量越轻的飞行器运行所需的能量就越少。
在过去十年里，我们的公司开发了四个原型机。
其中，Nexflight 最为自豪的是可以容纳六名乘客的模型。
诚然，25 公里的航程不算长，但这是一个很好的开始。
